description: SlideRule is a .NET architecture checker that enforces one C# spec and renders the same rules for coding agents. A rule is either the law (Enforce) or a ratchet over a counted baseline (Migrate). A scope either fails a new reference into it (Quarantine) or only warns when a change touches it (Caution). The tool checks a solution at the command line, in CI and when a coding agent's turn ends. Agents read the rules in a managed AGENTS.md block and per-directory rule cards, and query them over MCP with 'sliderule mcp'. It is built for long-lived, business-critical .NET codebases.
